items.title: Greenhouse gases aur un ke nuqsandeh asraat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the major greenhouse gases, their harmful effects and the Tidbits, printed pages 239-241.

items: Carbon Dioxide (CO₂): Yeh sab se ahem GHG hai. Yeh fossil fuels (koyla, tel aur gas) jalane aur jangalat ki katai (deforestation) se kharij hoti hai. Yeh GHG emissions ka taqreeban 80% hai.

Methane (CH₄): Yeh koyle aur gas ki paidawar ke dauran, maweshiyon (gaaye bhainson ke maide mein khameer, yaani enteric fermentation) aur kheti ke tareeqon se banti hai. Yeh emissions ka taqreeban 11% hai.
Nitrous Oxide (N₂O): Yeh kheti aur sanati sargarmiyon aur fossil fuels jalane se kharij hoti hai. Yeh emissions ka taqreeban 6% hai.

Fluorinated Gases (aaj zyada tar HFCs; purani qism chlorofluorocarbons): Yeh insan ki banayi hui (synthetic) gases hain jo sanati amal se kharij hoti hain (jaise purane fridge aur air conditioner). Yeh emissions ka taqreeban 3% hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne chhapa hai ke yeh feesad har gas ka global warming mein hissa hain. Asal mein yeh greenhouse gases ke kul emissions (CO2 ke barabar) mein hisse hain, jo America ke adaad hain. Garmi barhane ke asar (radiative forcing) ke lehaaz se lambi umr wali gases ke hisse taqreeban yeh hain: CO2 66%, methane 16%, nitrous oxide 6-7% aur halocarbons 11%. Kitab fluorinated gases ko chlorofluorocarbons kehti hai, halanke aaj in mein zyada tar HFCs hain.

blocks.alt: Do hisse. Qudrati greenhouse effect: suraj ki shuaain (solar radiation) greenhouse gases (CO2, H2O, CH4) ki patli teh aur atmosphere se guzar kar zameen tak; zameen se garmi wapas uthti hai, zyada garmi khala mein nikal jati aur kam garmi wapas lotti. Insani barhaya hua effect: zyada greenhouse gases (CO2, CH4, N2O) ki moti teh; kam garmi khala mein nikalti aur zyada garmi wapas zameen par lotti.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.9: Qudrati aur insani barhaya hua greenhouse effect (global warming ki aik wajah) (kitab ki Figure 25.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text:
World Meteorological Organization (WMO) ke mutabiq sanati daur se pehle (1900) hawa mein CO₂ ki miqdar taqreeban 280 parts per million (ppm) thi. 2026 mein yeh barh kar 428 ppm ho gayi hai aur abhi barh rahi hai.
Zameen ka asal ausat darja hararat 1900 se taqreeban 1°C barh chuka hai; is tabdeeli ko global warming kehte hain.

items: Global Warming: Zyada GHGs ke kharij hone se barha hua greenhouse effect global warming ki bari wajah hai. Global warming se murad insani sargarmiyon ki wajah se zameen ki ausat satahi hararat mein lamba izafa hai. Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) ki report (2023) ke mutabiq sanati daur se pehle (1850–1900) ke muqable mein zameen ki satah ka darja hararat taqreeban 1.1°C barh chuka hai.

Heatwaves (garmi ki lehrein): Global warming ne Jacobabad aur Sibi jaise shehron ko duniya ki sab se garam jaghon mein shamil kar diya hai. Jab hawa ka darja hararat 50°C se oopar jata hai to insani jism apna naarmal darja hararat qaim nahin rakh pata, aur heatstroke (loo lagna) jaan lewa ho sakta hai. Maweshi bhi garmi ka dabao (heat stress) sehte hain. Sardiyan chhoti aur garam ho jati hain, is liye keere makore aur machhar zyada arse tak zinda rehte hain. Garmi khushk-saali (drought) ko bhi barha sakti hai, aur garam, khushk mausam jangal ki aag (wildfires) ka khatra barhata hai.

Floods (sailab): Garam hawa zyada nami (moisture) rakhti hai, jis se be-qaaida aur shadeed barishein hoti hain. Is se be-qaaida aur "turbo-charged" (bohat taqatwar) monsoon aur sailab aate hain. Sailab jangalat, gharon aur kheti ko bohat nuqsan pohanchate hain. Yeh lambe arse ka nuqsan bhi karte hain, jaise mitti ka katao (soil erosion), mitti ke nutrients ka khatam hona aur paani ke zakheeron ki aaloodgi. Sailab se jaraseem (pathogens) tezi se barhte hain aur paani se phailne wali bimariyan phailti hain.

Glacial Melting (glaciers ka pighalna): Barha hua greenhouse effect glaciers ko pighlata hai. Pakistan mein qutbi (polar) ilaqon ke ilawa duniya ki kisi bhi jagah se zyada glaciers hain. Barhta darja hararat in glaciers (jaise Baltoro aur Batura) ko tezi se pighla raha hai, jis se Glacial Lake Outburst Floods (GLOFs) aate hain. 2025 mein Gilgit-Baltistan aur Chitral mein aise kai waqiaat hue jin mein pul aur poore gaon tabah ho gaye. Lambe arse mein agar glaciers khatam ho gaye to hamari zaraat ki lifeline, Indus River, sookh sakta hai.

Sea Level Rise aur Coastal Erosion (samandar ki satah ka barhna aur sahil ka katao): Jab qutbi barf pighalti hai aur garmi se samandar ka paani phailta hai to samandar ki satah oonchi hoti hai. Maslan Thatta aur Badin ke sahili ilaqe khatre mein hain, jahan samandar ka paani andar aa kar zarkhez zarai zameen ko namkeen daldal (salty marshes) bana raha hai.

Food Insecurity (khuraak ki kami ka khatra): Gandum aur chawal mein phool aane ke waqt zyada garmi daane ki paidawar ko kafi kam kar sakti hai. Isi tarah shadeed garmi mitti ki nami ura deti hai aur zarkhez zameen registan ban jati hai (desertification).

Ecosystem Disruption (ecosystem mein khalal): Darja hararat aur barish ke andaaz mein tez tabdeeliyan biodiversity ke liye sangeen khatra hain. Aisi tabdeeliyan species ko apne rehne ki jagah badalne ya hijrat (migrate) karne par majboor karti hain. Is se species khatre mein par jati hain aur khatam (extinct) bhi ho sakti hain.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Pakistan duniya ki GHG emissions ka 1% se bhi kam hissa deta hai, lekin climate change ke tabah-kun asraat se sab se zyada mutasir hone wale 10 mulkon mein shamil hai.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: June 2025 mein Pakistan mein shadeed barishon se bad-tareen sailab aaye. In sailabon se 1,000 se zyada amwaat hui, 3 million se zyada log be-ghar hue, 200,000 se zyada ghar tabah hue, aur tamam soobon aur Gilgit Baltistan mein kheti aur infrastructure (sarkon, pulon waghaira) ka wasee nuqsan hua. Yeh aafat monsoon se pehle ki shadeed barishon, glacial lake outburst floods aur cloudbursts (badal phatne) ki wajah se aayi.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text:
Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) glacier ki jheel ka qudrati bandh (maslan barf ka) tootne se paani ka achanak nikal parna hai.
GLOF ka paani apni jagah se 100 km se zyada door tak ja sakta hai aur bohat neeche ke ilaqon ko mutasir karta hai.
Cloudburst (badal phatna) chhote se ilaqe par thore se waqt mein achanak aur bohat shadeed barish hai.

blocks.prompt: Garam fiza zyada shadeed sailab kyun laati hai?
blocks.explanation: Garam hawa zyada nami rakhti hai, is liye barish zyada shadeed aur be-tarteeb jhatkon mein aati aur monsoon taqatwar ho jata hai.

items: Ahem GHGs: CO₂ (sab se ahem), CH₄, N₂O aur fluorinated gases; kitab ke 80/11/6/3% asal mein emissions ke hisse hain.
CO₂ 280 ppm (1900) se 428 ppm (2026); darja hararat taqreeban 1.1°C barh chuka (IPCC 2023).
Asraat: global warming, heatwaves, sailab, glaciers ka pighalna (GLOFs), samandar ki satah ka barhna, food insecurity, ecosystem mein khalal.
